text:
Maya: quick sync — Serve NextGen Q4 scope. Goal: unify chat/completions/embeddings/rerank under a single hosted endpoint and a simpler pricing surface. Need to agree MVB + launch guardrails before we convert to tickets.

Kevin: can we call out explicit SLO targets so eng can plan infra? thinking p95 latency targets and p99 tails per workload.

Ana: sounds good but we should be realistic. proposed split: Gold (Dedicated + burst): p95 < 120ms for short completions; Standard (shared): p95 < 300ms. Embeddings p99 < 250ms for Gold.

Sam: from customers: re-rank throughput > latency — some customers want batched rerank API or streaming rank. also they care about "top-k stability" across model variants.

Leo: proposal for v1: support synchronous per-request rerank and an async batch job API (jobs/v1). treat top-k stability as an evaluation metric, not a hard SLO for launch.

Maya: ok — draft launch criteria (brainstorm):
```
- API surface stable (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank combined)
- Perf benchmark (p95/p99) vs baseline on dedicated and shared
- Canary plan + rollback runbook
- Migration path for existing customers + compat header
- Pricing model defined (MVB plan + Gold/Standard tiers)
- Docs + quickstarts for common flows
- Eval harness passes on quality checks (embedding drift, rerank top-k)
```

ops-bot: Canary scheduled for 2169998000 across us-west-2. Canary policy: auto-fallback if +5% error-rate or +30ms p95 regression vs baseline.

Kevin: also add cost guardrails: default throttles + default quantization profile. suggestion: default embeddings quant=8q to reduce per-embedding unit cost ~30%.

Ana: quantization will affect quality. add an offline quality regression test and rollback threshold (e.g., R2 or recall drop > 2%).

Maya: action items: Kevin owns perf SLO matrix + benchmarking; Ana owns quality gates + evals; Sam owns migration strategy + API contract; Leo owns rollout runbook + canary thresholds. Sync Thursday 10am. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Sam: small note — for legacy clients we can add header `compat-mode: true` to keep behaviour while they migrate.

Maya: thanks everyone — I'm capturing this in the Serve NextGen draft https://redwood.internal/roadmaps/serve-nextgen (internal). I will open tickets after the Thursday sync.
